text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor

text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. No known chronic diseases. Social history: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.

speaker: Doctor
text: To help distinguish between potential causes like normal pressure hydrocephalus or a neurodegenerative disorder, does your memory or cognitive function seem to be declining as well? I would also like to know if you have experienced any falls or significant balance issues recently.
